description: [PAID $0.002 USDC per call via x402 on Base; errors are free] Reads allowance(owner, spender) for an ERC-20 token on Base mainnet (chain 8453) via public JSON-RPC eth_call (same free RPC pool as /api/base/token). Defaults: token=USDC, owner=vitalik.eth, spender=canonical Permit2 (0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3). Returns allowance in token units and raw integer, plus decimals/symbol/name. Invalid address = 400, RPC failure = 502, never charged. Informational only, not investment advice. One or two RPC batch calls; no paid upstream.

token.description: ERC-20 token address on Base (default USDC)
